title: Kubernetes Resource Requests, Limits & OOMKill
description: Understand Kubernetes compute resources: scheduling gating with requests, QoS classes, and memory limits enforcement with OOMKill

steps.title: 3. Memory Limits in Action & The OOMKiller

terminals.name: monitor
terminals.foreground: until [ -f .kube/config ]; do sleep 1; done; clear; watch -n 1 'kubectl get pods -o custom-columns=NAME:.metadata.name,STATUS:.status.phase,RESTARTS:.status.containerStatuses[0].restartCount,EXIT:.status.containerStatuses[0].lastState.terminated.exitCode,REASON:.status.containerStatuses[0].lastState.terminated.reason'
